items.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero

items.title: Measuring benchmark optimization in speech recognition
items.summary: Researchers are developing new methods to evaluate how speech recognition models are tuned for specific benchmarks. This process identifies whether improvements stem from genuine linguistic understanding or merely memorising test patterns to achieve higher scores.
items.why_it_matters: Accurate evaluation ensures that speech technologies perform reliably in real-world environments rather than just excelling on standardised tests, preventing companies from deploying overfitted, unreliable models.
